# cat

Concatenate files or standard input through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/cat first.txt second.txt

moonx cli/cat -n input.txt

printf 'hello\n' | moonx cli/cat
```

Read operands in order, using stdin when no file is supplied or an operand is -. Write stdout; formatting state continues across files.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-n`, `--number` | Number all lines. |
| `-b`, `--number-nonblank` | Number nonempty lines; overrides -n. |
| `-s`, `--squeeze-blank` | Collapse repeated empty lines. |
| `-A`, `--show-all` | Equivalent to -vET. |
| `-h`, `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

Use `--help` for the complete option list.

## Notes

With `-E`, a CR immediately before LF prints as `^M$`. A bare CR retains its byte value unless a nonprinting display option is active.

- -b takes precedence over -n. Visible-character formatting works on bytes; -u is accepted as a no-op.

Build from source with the MoonBit 1.0 RC1 toolchain.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
